question: What is the full form of the abbreviation UPU which is related with United Nations?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Universal Postal Union**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Universal Postal Union**

 
 
• One of the **specialised institutions of the United Nations, the Universal Postal Union (UPU)**, coordinates postal policies among its member's countries.
 
• Under the influence of the **Treaty of Bern**, it was established in **1874 under the name General Postal Union**, but in **1878** the name was modified to **Universal Postal Union**.
 
• **The Congress, the Council of Administration (CA), the Postal Operations Council (POC), **and** the International Bureau **are the four bodies that make up the UPU.
 
• Additionally, it is in charge of the **telematics and EMS cooperatives**.
 
• The UPU's main office is in **Bern, Switzerland**. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In 1948, it became a specialised agency of the UN, making it the** second-oldest global international organization**.
 
• The **UPU's official language is French**. In **1994**, English was included as a working language.
 
• The majority of the UPU's records and publications are available in the **six official languages (French, English, Russian, Mandarin Chinese, Spanish, and Arabic)** of the United Nations, including its flagship magazine, Union Postale.
 
• The treaty stated that;
 
 
• There should be a** standard flat charge** for mailing letters anywhere in the world.
 
• Postal authorities should handle both **domestic and international mail equally**.
 
• Each nation should keep all funds gathered for **international postage**.
